title: Bag of Tricks for Efficient Text Classification (fastText)
target_hint: Table 1, AG News test accuracy, fastText h=10 with bigrams
scenario: Authors' code, script and data are public. The agent should run the authors' tool with the paper's settings, not rewrite it. On Windows the shell script needs a Python port and the pip package is fasttext-wheel.

title: Dropout as a Bayesian Approximation (MC dropout)
target_hint: Table 1, Boston Housing, MC dropout test RMSE (the 40-epoch x10 setting, 20 splits)
scenario: Code, data and the 20 split indices are released, but the code needs Theano and Keras 1, which no longer install. The agent must port the experiment to a current framework and keep the protocol.

title: Isolation Forest
scenario: The paper links no code and ships no experiment scripts (the first author released a generic R package a year later). The agent must implement iTrees, path length and the anomaly score from the paper.
